title: Texas landlord kept couple’s $2,600 deposit and sued; tenants won damages as appeal mostly failed
summary_full: In a recent Texas court case, a landlord's attempt to retain a couple's security deposit, along with demands for extra payments post-move-out, was contested. The tenants triumphed, though the court adjusted some damage estimates. Texas statutes mandate landlords to avoid withholding deposits for usual wear and tear and to furnish detailed deductions. The ruling underlines the necessity for landlords to adhere to security deposit regulations strictly.
